hints.content:
The measure of an arc is equal to the measure of the [[☃ definition 1]] that intercepts it.

The arc measure of minor arc $\stackrel{\large{\frown}}{DC}$ is the measure of $\angle DPC$. We need to find the measure of  $\angle DPC$.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.definition: A central angle is an angle whose vertex is on the center of the circle.

options.alt: A circle that is centered around point P. Points A, B, C, and D all lie on this circle in a clockwise direction. Line segment B D and line segment A C are diameters of the circle. Line segments A P, B P, C P, and D P are radii of the circle. The angle A P B is a nineteen degree angle. Arc and angle C P D are highlighted.

hints.content: The measures of $\angle DPC$ and $\angle APB$ are congruent because they are vertical angles.
